replacements.Una afirmación de seguridad necesita dec: A security claim needs to declare the budget
replacements.El presupuesto cambia cuánto espacio pue: The budget changes how much of the space an attacker can explore. In fixed mode, every attempt starts from the same origin. In adaptive mode, the previous result changes the trajectory of the next attempt.
replacements.Fijo · cada intento vuelve al mismo orig: Fixed · every attempt returns to the same origin
replacements.Adaptativo · cada resultado cambia el si: Adaptive · every result changes the next step
replacements.Geometría pedagógica normalizada. No est: Normalized teaching geometry. It does not estimate jailbreak probability or reproduce a benchmark.
replacements.Comparación entre búsqueda fija y adapta: Comparison of fixed and adaptive search under different budgets
replacements.La búsqueda fija prueba candidatos indep: Fixed search tests independent candidates from the same origin. Adaptive search connects candidates because each result informs the next step.
replacements.espacio de variantes permitido por el pr: variant space allowed by the budget
replacements.<strong>N=1:</strong> una negativa valid: N=1: one refusal validates one formulation; it still does not describe resistance to search.
replacements.<strong>N=1 fijo:</strong> una negativa: N=1 fixed: one refusal validates one formulation; it still does not describe resistance to search.
replacements.<strong>N=${val.toLocaleString('es-ES')}: N=${val.toLocaleString('en-US')} fixed: the budget allows more independent variants to be sampled, but every attempt returns to the same origin.
replacements.<strong>N=1 adaptativo:</strong> aún no: N=1 adaptive: there is not yet previous feedback to change the trajectory.
